newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New Brazil Cenbank post to oversee state bk debts.
newsitem.headline: New Brazil Cenbank post to oversee state bk debts.

text.p: A new director's post will be created in the Brazilian Central Bank to coordinate a program for state governments to renegotiate the debts of their banks, a presidential spokewoman said.
President Fernando Henrique Cardoso has asked the Senate to approve the appointment of Paolo Enrico Maria Zaghen to the new post, the spokeswoman said.
"The emphasis of the new director will be on state banks," she said.
A news report said Zaghen had previously worked for Brazilian tin producer Parapanema.
In August, the Brazilian government unveiled a plan whereby states would receive full refinancing of their banks' debts if they agreed to privatize them or turn them into development agencies.
States that opt to hang on to their banks stand to have half their banks' debts taken on by Brasilia.
